description: HTML Export Viewer renders an HTML measure typically a styled table built in DAX and gives report users one-click buttons to export it to PDF, Excel, or Word. Unlike a plain "print the page" export, this visual preserves the actual on-screen formatting (colors, bold, alignment, borders) in every export format, and can optionally produce an Excel workbook with live, recalculating formulas instead of static numbers useful for tables where values are the result of a calculation (an escalation rate, a projection, a multi-year total) that a user may want to adjust after export. Key features: - Export the same content to PDF, Excel (.xlsx), or Word - Formatting-faithful exports matches the colors, bold text, alignment, and borders shown on screen - Optional live Excel formulas: mark specific cells with a formula template and a small set of named constants, and the Excel export writes real, recalculating formulas instead of baked-in values - Configurable toolbar: show/hide, button position, button text, export file name - No external services, no network access, no data collection see the linked privacy policy Setup requires a DAX measure that returns HTML content (a at minimum) see the linked documentation for the exact format and a full example, including how to enable the live-formula feature.
